target_claims.statement: Every nontrivial zero rho of the classical meromorphically continued Riemann zeta function satisfies Re(rho)=1/2, with trivial zeros and the pole at one excluded.

checker_contract.acceptance: Elaborate the exact target, kernel-check programmeRiemannHypothesis_eq_mathlib, verify the explicit zero taxonomy and pole exclusion, and report the axiom and placeholder inventory.
checker_contract.rejection: Reject elaboration alone as a proof of RH, reject ERH or GRH substitutions, and reject finite-height, density, statistical, or equivalent-criterion evidence as RH.

claim_boundary: This ready packet supplies a canonical statement interface and a definitional concordance theorem. It does not prove the Riemann Hypothesis.
blockers: RH-T-000 remains mathematically unproved; ready means eligible for MATHCERT interface replay only.
reopening_conditions: Reopen if the target declaration, mathlib identity, zero taxonomy, source concordance, or MATHCERT disposition changes.
